CustomField.description: Latest school tour the family attended: the newest Last Tour Attended of the primary guardian, the secondary guardian or the student. Kept up to date by the flow Campaign Member | Set Last Tour Attended.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISBLANK(Primary_Guardian__r.Last_Tour_Attended__c), ISBLANK(Secondary_Guardian__r.Last_Tour_Attended__c), ISBLANK(Account.Last_Tour_Attended__c) ), NULL, DATE(1900, 1, 1) + MAX( BLANKVALUE(Primary_Guardian__r.Last_Tour_Attended__c, DATE(1900, 1, 1)) - DATE(1900, 1, 1), BLANKVALUE(Secondary_Guardian__r.Last_Tour_Attended__c, DATE(1900, 1, 1)) - DATE(1900, 1, 1), BLANKVALUE(Account.Last_Tour_Attended__c, DATE(1900, 1, 1)) - DATE(1900, 1, 1) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date of the latest school tour this family attended. Filled in automatically when attendance is marked on a School Tours campaign.
CustomField.label: Date Attended Tour
